clubs.description: Phi Alpha Delta is an undergraduate pre‑law fraternity that offers academic panels, networking, and philanthropy events. Members meet in business‑casual attire to discuss legal topics and support community causes.

clubs.name: Phi Chi Theta
clubs.about: Co‑ed professional business fraternity for networking, skill building, and career growth.
clubs.description: Phi Chi Theta is a co‑ed professional business fraternity open to all majors, offering networking and career‑building events. Members meet for speaker panels, fundraisers, and social gatherings on campus.

clubs.name: Philosophy of Medicine
clubs.about: To provide discussion of medical philosophy to prehealth professionals.
clubs.description: To provide discussion of medical philosophy to prehealth professionals. Here, we will try to answer “what is medicine” using a core of philosophy and approaches to modern dilemmas in medicine.

clubs.name: PrePharmacy Club
clubs.about: UW Pre‑Pharmacy Club supports students pursuing pharmacy careers with resources.
clubs.description: The UW Pre‑Pharmacy Club provides resources like CASPer preparation sessions and health‑topic talks for aspiring pharmacists. Members share study tips, host events, and build a supportive community.

clubs.name: Product Space @ UW
clubs.about: Develops product leadership skills and hosts product challenges.
clubs.description: Product Space cultivates future product leaders by linking students nationwide and hosting product competitions with real‑world challenges, prizes, and networking opportunities.

clubs.name: Program on Climate Change Undergraduate Cohort
clubs.about: Undergrad cohort for climate science community.
clubs.description: The UW Program on Climate Change Undergraduate Cohort brings together students interested in climate science, research, and policy. Through panels, workshops, and networking, members explore academic and career pathways in climate-related fields. Join us to learn, collaborate, and make an impact on climate solutions.

clubs.name: Project Sunshine at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Project Sunshine is an organization that comforts and attempts to normalize inpatient pediatrics lives through the…
clubs.description: Project Sunshine is an organization that comforts and attempts to normalize inpatient pediatrics lives through the power of play! We also make cards for local hospitals and send Sending Sunshine activity kits to hospitals nationwide.

clubs.name: Q Center
clubs.about: Affirming space and resources for queer, trans, and allied students.
clubs.description: The UW Q Center offers a safe, celebratory environment with services like a menstruation station, mentorship programs, and discussion groups. Drop by HUB 315 Mon‑Thu 11 am‑4 pm to get involved and find support.

clubs.name: Q plus plus
clubs.about: LGBTQ+ community events for Allen School students.
clubs.description: Q++ creates a welcoming space for LGBTQ+ and allied students in the Allen School through craft nights, meals, and community building activities. Come share creativity and make connections in CSE1 305.

clubs.name: Queer Cinema History at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Weekly queer film screenings for all majors and allies.
clubs.description: The Queer Cinema Club hosts regular movie nights showcasing LGBTQ+ stories, from classics to new releases. Join the relaxed gatherings on Wednesdays in SAV 138 to watch, discuss, and connect with fellow film lovers.

clubs.name: Salsa Club at UW
clubs.about: Weekly salsa and bachata lessons for all skill levels
clubs.description: The UW Salsa Club offers fun, inclusive dance nights where anyone can learn salsa or bachata without a partner. Classes feature guest instructors and bilingual announcements, making it a vibrant cultural hub on campus. Join the Thursday sessions to practice moves and enjoy the rhythm.

clubs.name: SherePunjab Society at University of Washington
clubs.about: Celebrates Punjabi culture with food socials and fun gatherings.
clubs.description: The Sher‑E‑Punjab Society promotes Punjabi heritage on campus through cultural events. Members enjoy traditions like mango lassi socials, gol gappa contests, and game nights that bring the community together.

clubs.name: Society of Asian Scientists and Engineers
clubs.about: Professional network for Asian scientists and engineers at UW.
clubs.description: SASE UW brings together Asian students in science and engineering for workshops, networking, and industry talks. Participate in events like networking skill sessions and lunch‑and‑learns with firms such as ARUP.

clubs.name: Society of Physics Students
clubs.about: Involving students from all backgrounds and supporting them.
clubs.description: Involving students from all backgrounds and supporting them. Creating a stimulating and motivating community of physics enthusiasts. Encouraging creativity beyond the classroom to push the boundaries of science and have fun while doing that.

clubs.name: Society of Women Engineers at UW
clubs.about: Supports women and nonbinary students in engineering and tech through events.
clubs.description: Society of Women Engineers at UW supports women and nonbinary students in engineering and tech through social events, networking, and creative activities like gingerbread house decorating and campus treat booths.

clubs.name: Software Engineering Career Club
clubs.about: Provides career resources and workshops for aspiring software engineers.
clubs.description: SWE Career Club connects UW students pursuing software engineering with industry professionals through panels, tech showcases, and hands‑on workshops. Recent events include an Accenture career panel and a session with the OpenAI Student Collective on building AI application agents.

clubs.name: Somali Student Association
clubs.about: Supports Somali students and showcases Somali culture.
clubs.description: Somali Student Association provides a hub for Somali students to celebrate culture, host creative talks, and engage in civic activities such as voter‑education events. Activities include poetry launches, board opportunities, and community discussions.

clubs.name: South Asian Student Association at UW
clubs.about: Fosters South Asian community and culture at UW.
clubs.description: South Asian Student Association unites students from South Asian backgrounds with events like pie‑the‑member socials and leadership introductions. The group offers cultural programming and a supportive community for students across majors.

clubs.name: Student Mycology Club
clubs.about: Our club wants to create an educated community full of mushroom enthusiasts and people who care about the environment.
clubs.description: Our club wants to create an educated community full of mushroom enthusiasts and people who care about the environment.

clubs.name: Sumo Union Membership Organization
clubs.about: Huskies who want to watch Japanese Grand Sumo with some friends.
clubs.description: Huskies who want to watch Japanese Grand Sumo with some friends. Primarily meeting during each of the six yearly tournaments. Join the Discord! https://discord.gg/j2D7s9hrBF Follow the Instagram! https://www.instagram.com/sumo.uw/

clubs.name: Sustainable Education Initiative
clubs.about: SEI is a group of undergraduate students working to establish a Sustainability General Education Requirement on campus.
clubs.description: SEI is a group of undergraduate students working to establish a Sustainability General Education Requirement on campus.

clubs.name: Synaptech at University of Washington
clubs.about: Synaptech is an engineering RSO dedicated to advancing neurotechnology through hands-on student projects and…
clubs.description: Synaptech is an engineering RSO dedicated to advancing neurotechnology through hands-on student projects and interdisciplinary education. We focus on developing real-world applications using neural interfaces while exploring the vital intersections of neuroscience, neural engineering, and neuroethics. By providing accessible hardware resources and fostering a collaborative community, we empower students to transform their ideas into impactful innovations. We're open to everyone, from all majors!

clubs.name: Taiko Kai
clubs.about: Taiko Kai’s purpose is to celebrate and share the traditional Japanese performing art of taiko drumming across all…
clubs.description: Taiko Kai’s purpose is to celebrate and share the traditional Japanese performing art of taiko drumming across all communities by educating each other on the artform and cultural significance. UW students can join regardless of experience or background; we aim to nurture everyone's curiosity about taiko. Taiko Kai offers holistic development through providing a variety of opportunities for members to be involved: typical practices for honing drumming techniques, the maintenance and care of our equipment, creative work such as uniform-making and designing promotional material, and experiencing the range of venues and organizations that invite us to perform for them. Through our efforts to bring taiko to all audiences while providing the space for members to contribute how they want to, we've cultivated a space that upholds our values of inclusivity and empowerment.

clubs.name: Taiwanese Student Association
clubs.about: Shares Taiwanese culture via events, food, and community.
clubs.description: Taiwanese Student Association shares Taiwanese culture through night markets, trivia evenings, and snack‑filled gatherings, plus offers digital membership perks. Members enjoy games, food, and opportunities to learn about Taiwan.

clubs.name: Tea Club
clubs.about: A student group that shares and enjoys tea together.
clubs.description: The official Tea Club at UW brings together anyone who loves tea. Members meet for tastings, collaborations with studios, and themed events like Scary Sipping. Join their Discord for the latest meet‑up info.

clubs.name: Technology and Business Association
clubs.about: Explores tech and business topics via panels and interactive talks.
clubs.description: TBA @ UW connects students with professionals to discuss technology, entrepreneurship, and the future of mobility. Their interactive panel talks let members hear diverse perspectives and vote on hot topics.

clubs.name: Thai Student Association at University of Washington
clubs.about: Thai student association celebrating Thai culture and community.
clubs.description: ThaiSA UW is the official Thai Student Association at UW, hosting cultural events and fun activities like the Northwest Sports Day. Members get to play sports, meet new friends, and share Thai traditions.

clubs.name: The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students ( FIUTS ) Student Board
clubs.about: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through…
clubs.description: FIUTS (The Foundation for International Understanding Through Students) advances international understanding through crosscultural experiences, student leadership, and community connections.

clubs.name: The Hiking Club at UW
clubs.about: Student hiking club organizing year‑round trail outings across Washington.
clubs.description: The UW Hiking Club brings students together for trail adventures throughout Washington, from waterfalls to mountain peaks. Members stay updated via Discord, where they share trip details and organize collaborations like the Snow Club cold‑plunge. All skill levels are welcome to explore the outdoors.

clubs.name: The Women’s Network at UW
clubs.about: The Women’s Network is an organization that encourages and promotes the empowerment of women.
clubs.description: The Women’s Network is an organization that encourages and promotes the empowerment of women. The mission of the club is to inspire and empower women of all ages, backgrounds and interests to act on their own ambitions.

clubs.name: Tzu Chi Collegiate Association Seattle Chapter
clubs.about: The Tzu Chi Collegiate Association at Seattle (Seattle & UW Tzu Ching) is the servicebased collegiate organization…
clubs.description: The Tzu Chi Collegiate Association at Seattle (Seattle & UW Tzu Ching) is the servicebased collegiate organization that carries out the missions of the Tzu Chi Foundation. The Tzu Ching club provides an opportunity for volunteer work in the local area.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Business Council
clubs.about: Fosters leadership, collaboration, and mentorship among UW business students.
clubs.description: The Undergraduate Business Council cultivates leadership and networking for business students. Activities include mentorship pairings, fireside chats with first‑generation professionals, and informal meet‑ups with snacks and peer support.

clubs.name: Undergraduate Theater Society
clubs.about: Creates inclusive theatre productions and learning opportunities for undergrads.
clubs.description: The Undergraduate Theatre Society offers inclusive, student‑run theatre productions and learning experiences. They hold events such as town halls, rehearsals for shows like Trouble in Mind, and themed gatherings like Ghostlight.

clubs.name: United Nations Association University of Washington Chapter
clubs.about: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN…
clubs.description: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN and strengthen the UN system. We advocate for the UN, stand up for human rights, and learn how to meet UN sustainability goals.

clubs.name: UW Recreation
clubs.about: University recreation department offering activities for student wellbeing.
clubs.description: UW Recreation provides a wide range of activities to support student health and fun, from climbing classes to paddle‑board events. They offer a one‑day Belay Techniques class and seasonal events like the Witches Paddle with equipment supplied. All programs aim to be safe, accessible, and welcoming.

clubs.name: @uw_oscmc
clubs.about: Student club focused on supply chain and operations management.
clubs.description: OSCMC hosts networking events for students interested in supply chain and operations. Their Fall Networking Night offers meaningful conversations and insights into the field. Connect with peers and professionals to expand your knowledge.

clubs.name: @uw_stf
clubs.about: Provides funding support and proposal guidance for student projects.
clubs.description: The @uw_stf club offers workshops to guide students through the proposal and funding process. Their Fall Quarter Proposal Workshop helps members craft strong project proposals.

clubs.name: Viable Veganism at UW
clubs.about: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty.
clubs.description: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty. We welcome everyone.

clubs.name: VSAUW
clubs.about: Vietnamese student association fostering community and culture.
clubs.description: VSAUW is the Vietnamese Student Association at UW, offering cultural events, info nights, and community gatherings. Members celebrate Vietnamese heritage, connect with peers, and enjoy activities throughout the semester.

clubs.name: Washington Men’s Gymnastics
clubs.about: Men's gymnastics team representing UW in competitions and community clinics.
clubs.description: Washington Men’s Gymnastics showcases the university’s gymnastics talent, sharing training highlights and hosting holiday clinics for the community.

clubs.name: Washington Public Interest Research Group
clubs.about: WashPIRG is a a nonpartisan, studentrun organization dedicated to making a difference on issues students care about.
clubs.description:
WashPIRG is a a nonpartisan, studentrun organization dedicated to making a difference on issues students care about. We give students the skills and opportunities to mobilize and advocate for social change.
Get involved at washpirgstudents.org!

clubs.name: WGA Magic: The Gathering
clubs.about: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a…
clubs.description: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a variety of different formats. Join the discord to learn more about how to get involved here https://discord.gg/Mfmg84f

clubs.name: WiUX: Women in User Experience
clubs.about: Connects and empowers women in UX and related fields via workshops and networking.
clubs.description: Women in User Experience creates a network for women interested in UX at UW. They offer virtual workshops on portfolio planning, personal branding, and design skills, and host regular events to share tips and support each other.

clubs.name: Women Empowerment through Collaborations, Awareness, and Resources for Education
clubs.about: WECARE works to empower women globally through expanding resources for health, education, and more.
clubs.description: WECARE works to empower women globally through expanding resources for health, education, and more. We aim to create an environment where students from all backgrounds and identities can gain a sense of community together between shared values. Through workshops, outreach, and collaborations with community partners, we aim to close knowledge gaps and reduce stigma surrounding topics that are often overlooked in traditional education. We understand that education is empowerment. WECARE is one of the founding RSOs of the Pregnancy Test Access Project, bringing free pregnancy tests to UW's campus, available for all students! More info on our Instagram @wecareuw.

clubs.name: Women in Chemical Engineering at the University of Washington
clubs.about: Supports and mentors women in chemical engineering through community events and professional development.
clubs.description: Women in Chemical Engineering builds a supportive community for female chemE students at UW. They host mentorship events, professional‑development workshops, and an annual industry speaker series featuring alumni like Jamie Clark and Denise.

clubs.name: Women in Computing
clubs.about: Supports women and non‑binary CSE students with mentorship and tech events.
clubs.description: Women in Computing creates a supportive space for women and non‑binary students in computer science. They host mentorship panels, social gatherings like Friendsgiving, and events that highlight diverse tech career paths.

clubs.name: Women’s Rugby at UW
clubs.about: UW women's rugby team open to all interested players.
clubs.description: Womxn’s Husky Rugby Club fields a competitive women’s rugby team open to all interested players. The club posts game updates, practices, and fun team activities like themed costume practices.

clubs.name: Women’s Water Polo Club at University of Washington
clubs.about: University women’s water polo team competing in Northwest Division
clubs.description: UW Women’s Water Polo fields a competitive team that has won multiple division titles, most recently from 2023‑2026. The club streams games like the upcoming Aztec Invitational, keeping fans updated throughout the weekend. Players train hard and represent the Dawgs in regional tournaments.

clubs.name: Woof3D
clubs.about: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing.
clubs.description: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we have something for everyone. Experience is not required, and neither is any time commitment. During Fall Quarter, we hold weekly workshops mostly aimed towards beginners. These will teach the basics of 3D modeling in OnShape, as well as how to print using the club printers. We also provide members with the opportunity to work on a larger scale 3D printing project with other members throughout the year. Joining a team is not required, but it is a good way to get hands on experience and learn more about hardware and software in the process. Check out our website to learn more!

clubs.name: Writers in Progress
clubs.about: Interested in creative writing?
clubs.description: Interested in creative writing? We create a positive, casual space where people interested in a variety of forms of creative writing can meet and provide each other with support and feedback. Bring something to share or just come to chat! :)
